commit.message:
mtd: nand: spi: Kconfig: Reorder SPI NAND option blocks and gate defaults on RV1106

Reorder the SPI NAND Kconfig entries so the type keyword precedes the
default assignment consistently, matching the standard Kconfig layout.
For several controllers, change the unconditional 'default y' to
'default y if !ROCKCHIP_RV1106' to avoid enabling them on platforms
for code size optimize.

Change-Id: I0e1841dd4a0a45e666182f663e2cd5314b1566c9
Signed-off-by: Jon Lin <jon.lin@rock-chips.com>
